answer.worked:
The missing $a$ coefficient is $11-5=6$. Adding $7b$ cancels $-7b$.
$$\begin{align*}5a-7b+6a+7b&=(5+6)a+(-7+7)b\\&=11a\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}4c+2d+1+3c+7d+4&=(4+3)c+(2+7)d+(1+4)\\&=7c+9d+5\end{align*}$$
The missing numbers, from left to right, are $7,\ 9,\ 5$.

$$\begin{align*}8a^2b+6b^2a+2a^2b+b^2a&=(8+2)a^2b+(6+1)b^2a\\&=10a^2b+7b^2a\\&=7b^2a+10a^2b\end{align*}$$
